pieces.source_norm: L2(dr; Hhalf f0 direct_sum Hthreehalf fr direct_sum Hthreehalf ftheta), physical frequencies 4k and mean weight one
pieces.scope: complete actual real radial interval and whole real parameter family; no root/positive collar is crossed

forward.complete_source_Gram_rule: For the full five-input G in the common strong source space, the zero-initial physical endpoint (u,pbar) Gram is bounded by physical_source_operator_upper squared times G. No omitted input column or uncharged frame is included.

backward.complete_source_Gram_rule: For the full five-input G in the common strong source space, the zero-initial physical endpoint (u,pbar) Gram is bounded by physical_source_operator_upper squared times G. No omitted input column or uncharged frame is included.

source_convention: f0=-R0, fr=Rr, ftheta=Rtheta, shifted physical momentum=p_N
regular_cap_column: The sixth regular low input has zero direct core forcing and is retained in the separate full cap/Schur map.
limits: all local fields and parameter errors are retained
ordinary core, real roots and positive collars are separate
actual canonical/root/label source frame not paid here
no full high inverse or nonlinear correction is asserted
